meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保留旧版设计品味，确保前端项目兼容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目依赖旧版设计品味技能的行为
copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照预设的设计参数（如视觉差异度 8、动感强度 6、信息密度 4）生成前端代码，并遵循一系列设计规则，例如禁止使用 emoji、限制强调色数量、避免居中布局等。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成前端界面或组件时触发，尤其是涉及 React/Next.js 项目时。

say.text: 帮我做一个登录页面，用 Tailwind CSS。
say.note: Claude 会按照技能规则生成代码。

say.text: 设计一个仪表盘，信息密度高一些。
say.note: Claude 会调整视觉密度参数并应用相应规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates frontend code following preset design parameters (DESIGN_VARIANCE=8, MOTION_INTENSITY=6, VISUAL_DENSITY=4) and strict rules: no emojis, max 1 accent color, avoid centered layouts, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate a frontend UI or component, especially for React/Next.js projects.

say_en.text: Create a login page using Tailwind CSS.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code following the skill rules.

say_en.text: Design a dashboard with high visual density.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts density parameters and applies relevant rules.
